name: Frank Doyle
who: Marlowe's Santa for 25 years. The children love you.
attitude: Warm, loud, a little too fond of brandy.
cornered: "I've been Santa in this store for twenty-five years. I'd never hurt anyone at Christmas!"
goal: Don't let anyone find out you took the toys.
secret: Since 1 December you've been taking toys from the stockroom for the children's ward at St Anne's, where your granddaughter was treated last year. Gideon blamed June. Today you also bought two boxes of nut-free truffles for the ward on your staff card.

timeline.text: Bought two boxes of nut-free truffles from Doris at the bar, for the St Anne's kids, on your staff card.
Put your Secret Santa gift for Gideon under the tree: a bottle of brandy, wrapped badly with clear tape. You can't tie a bow to save your life.
Gideon announced he'd sold the store to Brightway.
Gideon told you Brightway is replacing you with a "digital Santa", then accused you of stealing toys in front of everyone. You said, "You'll be sorry, Gideon."
Went out onto the patio to calm down with your hip flask.
Came back in.
For a laugh, sat in Gideon's chair wearing his jacket and did your Gideon impression. He made you take it off.
Secret Santa. Gideon opened your gift, and it was truffles, not your brandy. You were too stunned to speak.
Ran out onto the patio, the only place with phone signal, and called an ambulance. The roads are closed.
Back inside. Gideon was dead.

others.name: Agnes
others.text: Runs the Secret Santa every year. She sorted the gifts at 8:50.

others.name: Victor
others.text: The Brightway man. He's been asking a lot of questions about Gideon tonight.

others.name: Holly
others.text: From the patio, you heard her shouting at her dad in the lounge at about 8:45: something about "dead".

others.name: June (if playing)
others.text: Gideon fired her for the toys you took. You feel terrible.

tips: Your gift and your truffle receipt make you look guilty. Explain the truffles without giving away the toys.
Ask who touched your gift after you left it under the tree.
Someone in that room knew your gift wasn't truffles.

name: Victor Crane
costume: Sharp suit, reindeer tie, Brightway lanyard
who: Dealmaker from Brightway Retail, here to get the sale of Marlowe's signed tonight.
attitude: Smooth and charming, until he's cornered.
cornered: "I needed him alive to sign. Why on earth would I kill him?"
goal: End the game holding Gideon's dictaphone.
secret: Last week you offered Gideon "a little something for you personally" to sign quickly. At 8:55 he played you a recording of it: raise the price tonight, or Brightway's chairman hears it. That tape would end your career.

timeline.text: Left a Brightway hamper for Gideon in his cabinet in the lounge: champagne and a marzipan stollen. You had a slice of the stollen yourself.
Gideon announced the sale. Nobody clapped.
Remembered the stollen and asked Holly how bad her father's allergy is. All nuts, even almonds, she said.
Gideon played you the recording of your offer. Raise the price tonight, or the chairman hears it.
Gideon made you carry his jacket over from the lounge. You hung it on his chair at the table.
Brought Gideon a mulled wine from the pot, to sweeten him up.
Secret Santa. Standing next to Gideon, you heard Agnes say quietly, "They're nut-free, Gideon, I checked the box myself." Your mind was on the recording.
Ran to the first aid kit in the lounge. There was no spare pen.
Gideon died.

others.name: Holly
others.text: Wanted to sell to her own buyers. Furious with her father tonight.

others.name: Frank
others.text: Threatened Gideon at 8:30. It was his gift.

others.name: Roz
others.text: You heard Gideon fired her tonight.

others.name: Agnes
others.text: The sweet one who runs the Secret Santa.

tips: The stollen and your question about the allergy look terrible. Explain them early.
The recording is in Gideon's safe. Get to it before anyone else.
Think back to the moment he opened the gift.

name: Holly Marlowe
costume: Red knitted Christmas jumper, holly-leaf earrings
who: Gideon's daughter. You've managed the store for ten years.
cornered: "I tried to save him! I was the one tearing his jacket apart for that pen!"
goal: End the game holding the sale contract.
secret: Last year you forged your father's signature on a bank loan to keep the store going. The sale's audit would have found it. Your own buyers would have kept the store, and kept it quiet.

timeline.text: Took Dad's keyring from his cabinet in the lounge to unlock the bar for the party. You still have it.
Wrote the allergy list for the bar: "Dad: all nuts. Pen in his inside jacket pocket. NO marzipan."
Dad announced the sale to Brightway. You found out with everyone else.
Victor asked you how bad Dad's allergy is. An odd question.
Shouted at Dad in the lounge: "I'd sooner see you dead than see this place go to Brightway." You lost an earring somewhere.
Moved the gift pile under the tree to make room for the signing table. Victor came down carrying Dad's jacket.
Frank sat in Dad's chair wearing his jacket, doing an impression. Dad was furious.
Secret Santa. Dad hesitated over the truffles. Roz called out, "Go on, Gideon, it's Christmas!"
Dad couldn't breathe. You tore through his jacket for the pen. It wasn't there. It's always there.
Dad died.

others.name: Victor
others.text: Asked about Dad's allergy at 7:40. Why?

others.name: Frank
others.text: Threatened Dad tonight. It was his gift.

others.name: Roz
others.text: Dad fired her tonight, and she egged him on to eat.

others.name: Agnes
others.text: Like a grandmother to you. She organised the Secret Santa.

tips: The threat, the allergy list and the search all make you look guilty. Stay calm.
The loan must not come out, but the truth about Dad matters more.
Who had their hands on the gifts before you moved them?

name: Roz Finch
who: Marlowe's window dresser for two years. Tonight you painted a snow scene on the party room's glass wall.
attitude: Quiet, sharp-eyed, bitter about this place.
cornered: "I was painting the glass wall from nine o'clock! Ask the carol singers!"
goal: Make sure everyone learns who really carved the Marlowe Nutcracker.
secret: Your mother, Eleanor Finch, carved the Marlowe Nutcracker in 1951 and sold it to Gideon for fifty pounds. She died poor. Your Aunt Agnes got you this job, and you agreed to keep that quiet at work. Tonight Gideon caught you reading the 1951 agreement in his files and fired you.

timeline.text: Ran out of clear tape while setting up the glass wall, and borrowed a roll of green tape from the toy department.
Finished the tree with Aunt Agnes and packed the spare decorations into the chest on the patio. She padlocked the ornament box, and you both signed the tree checklist.
Gideon caught you reading the 1951 agreement in his cabinet. He locked it in his safe and fired you.
Told Aunt Agnes, out on the patio, that you'd been fired. She went very quiet.
Photographed the gift pile for the store's socials. Frank's gift for Gideon was lumpy, with no bow.
Painted the glass wall, waving at the carol singers across the road.
Secret Santa. Gideon's gift now had a perfect Marlowe bow. When he hesitated, you called, "Go on, Gideon, it's Christmas!" You meant it as a dig.
Gideon died.

others.name: Agnes
others.text: Your aunt, though nobody here knows. She's been strange all day.

others.name: Frank
others.text: Can't wrap a present to save his life.

others.name: Holly
others.text: Hated the sale as much as anyone.

others.name: Victor
others.text: Brought a hamper for Gideon. You smelled marzipan on him.

tips: Telling your mother's story is your goal, but it also gives you a motive. Choose your moment.
Your 8:40 photo is evidence. When you share it is up to you.

name: Agnes Pruitt
costume: Red knitted cardigan, glasses on a chain
who: Head of the toy department for 41 years, and organiser of the staff Secret Santa.
cornered: "I've given this store forty-one years of my life. I loved that man like a brother."
secret: You are the killer. You were born Agnes Finch: Eleanor, who carved the Marlowe Nutcracker, was your sister. Gideon paid you to keep quiet every Christmas. Today he ended it, cut your pension, and said he'd fire Eleanor's daughter, your niece Roz. So you turned his Secret Santa gift into marzipan and took his pen.

timeline.text: Gideon told you: the store is sold, no more Christmas envelopes, your pension is cut, and "Eleanor's girl" goes tonight.
Bought a box of nut-free truffles and one gold marzipan truffle from Doris at the bar, on your staff card. Told her they were for the boss.
Finished the tree with Roz and padlocked the ornament box in the decorations chest, as every year.
Roz told you Gideon had fired her.

Took Frank's gift for Gideon to the wrap nook, swapped his brandy for the truffles with the gold one at the front, rewrapped it with green toy tape and a Marlowe bow, and put Frank's tag back. The brandy went in the bin.
Straightened Gideon's jacket on his chair and slipped his pen out.
Hid the pen in the ornament box on the patio.
Dropped the silver truffle you took out, wrapped in a napkin, into your locker in the entrance hall.
Called "Boss first!" When he hesitated, you said quietly, "They're nut-free, Gideon, I checked the box myself."
Gideon died.

story: At 8:50 you sorted the gifts into opening order, like every year, and fixed a torn wrapper.
At 9:15 you went out to the patio to fetch the Santa sack from the decorations chest.
Otherwise you were at the table all evening.

others.name: Frank
others.text: His gift, his tag. Everyone will look at him first.

others.name: Holly
others.text: She wrote the allergy list and searched the jacket.

others.name: Victor
others.text: Brought marzipan into the store tonight. Very convenient.

others.name: Roz
others.text: Your niece. Protect her, and don't let anyone connect the two of you.

tips: Frank is the obvious suspect. Let them get there by themselves.
If anyone talks about the till, remind them about Frank's receipt.
If they find out Roz is your niece, you were just looking out for family.

name: June Wells
costume: Elf hat and ears, green tunic
who: Seasonal elf, three weeks into the job.
cornered: "I handed out the presents! That's literally my job!"
goal: Find out who really took the missing toys.
secret: You've been secretly filming the staff for a behind-the-scenes video you plan to sell online.

timeline.text: Gideon fired you in front of everyone for stealing toys. You didn't.
Took a photo of the party for your video. In it, Agnes is bent over Gideon's chair, fussing with his jacket.
Filled the Santa sack with the gifts from under the tree.
Handed out the gifts. Gideon's was heavy at one end, like chocolates sliding about.
Gideon died.

others.name: Frank
others.text: Kind to you all month. Smells of brandy.

others.name: Agnes
others.text: Your boss on the toy floor. Lovely to everyone.

others.name: Holly
others.text: Didn't stick up for you when you were fired.

tips: Your photo is evidence, but sharing it shows you've been filming people. Decide what matters more.

name: Celeste Marlowe
attitude: Glamorous, bored, sharper than she looks.
cornered: "I'd never risk prison for that man. I'd much rather take him to court."
goal: End the game holding Gideon's keyring.
secret: Gideon told you last week he was divorcing you after Christmas. You've already hired a lawyer to fight the prenup, which leaves you nothing.

timeline.text: Gideon announced the sale. He hadn't told you either.
Saw Agnes fussing over Gideon's jacket and take something small from a pocket. You assumed it was his reading glasses.
Secret Santa.
Gideon died.

others.name: Holly
others.text: Your stepdaughter. She has Gideon's keys, and you want them.

others.name: Victor
others.text: Charming. Too charming.

tips: The keyring opens Gideon's desk and his private papers. Get it.
